title: Numaish Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Numaish Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: Opposite to Hussaini Blood Bank, Near Numaish Chowrangi. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=24.8718942,67.0345009. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
